steps.does: boot the machine to the debug shell
run `usbdiskprobe write`
run `usbdiskprobe hold` and pull the stick through QMP once it holds the mount
plug a stick of the same image back in behind the hub through QMP, and run `usbdiskprobe replug`

assertions.checks: the machine boots to the debug shell
`usbdiskprobe write` writes a file to the FAT volume, syncs and unmounts it, reads it back after a remount, prints `USBDISKPROBE OK` and exits 0

`usbdiskprobe hold`, with the stick pulled once it prints `USBDISKPROBE HOLDING`, reads the partition until a read answers EIO, then finds a cached listing and a read, a write and an open on the mount answer EIO, the disk and the mount gone from /proc/disk and the mount table, and the unmount refused while the file is open and done once it is closed, prints `USBDISKPROBE OK` and exits 0
after the plug the kernel writes `usbdisk: disk0: mbr`
`usbdiskprobe replug` mounts the volume again and reads the file back, prints `USBDISKPROBE OK` and exits 0
the console up to the last record waited for has no line with `USBDISKPROBE FAIL`
